observation.visible_scene: A white seamless studio box. Centered on a white plate is a short white cylindrical bottle/container. Protruding vertically from the bottle's mouth is an elongated red column capped by a rounded greenish-gray lump. A small Olaf snowman figurine stands on the plate to the left of the bottle. A red liquid/paint smear pools around the bottle's base and extends toward the figurine.
visible_changes: The greenish-gray lump on top of the red column shows a very slight, slow downward sag/deformation over the excerpt: the green-red boundary edge creeps a little lower and the lump's silhouette droops marginally by the last frame.
The red liquid pool on the plate appears to spread a touch outward over time, edging slightly closer to the Olaf figurine and advancing a little along its front rim.
The bottle, the figurine, and the plate remain in fixed positions; the background corner lines of the box do not shift, indicating no noticeable camera movement.
The red column's overall height and the figurine's pose stay essentially unchanged throughout.
The scene is largely static apart from these subtle deformations/spreading.
outside_clip_unknowns: What placed or extruded the red-and-green mass onto the bottle, and what produced the red liquid on the plate.
Whether the drooping and spreading continue, stop, or reverse after the last frame.
The material identities of the green lump, red column, and red pool.
Any earlier or later contact involving the Olaf figurine.
uncertain_details: It is unclear whether the slight sagging of the green lump and the apparent spreading of the red pool are genuine physical motion or artifacts of lighting/compression, since the changes are very small.
Minor pixel-level framing differences between frames could be camera jitter or noise; no deliberate camera motion is supported.
